broker.name: Admirals
broker.tagline: Its site names CySEC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:30.
broker.about: The Admirals pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Trade.MT4, Zero.MT4, Zero.MT4 and Zero.MT5, and Invest.MT5. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, Admirals mobile app, Web trading, and MetaTrader Supreme Edition. The site names these regulators: CySEC. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:30. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

plans.name: Trade.MT4
plans.billing_note: Spread pricing, spreads from 0.5 pips. No commissions except stock CFDs. Retail leverage up to 1:30. Minimum trade size 0.01 lots. CFDs on forex, indices, metals, cryptocurrencies, energy and stocks.

plans.name: Zero.MT4
plans.billing_note: Commission-based pricing, spreads from 0.0 pips. Retail leverage up to 1:30. CFDs on forex, indices, metals and energy.

plans.name: Zero.MT4 and Zero.MT5
plans.billing_note: Forex and metals commission per 1.0 lot per side, then doubled for the round turn and charged when the order is opened. USD account: 3.0 up to 10 million USD monthly volume, 2.4 from 10 million to 50 million, 1.8 over 50 million. EUR: 2.6, 2.1 and 1.6.

plans.name: Invest.MT5

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Trade.MT4 and Zero.MT4: 100 EUR or 100 USD. The site defines this as EUR 100 or equivalent in another supported currency. The account-types comparison table did not render, so MT5 minimums were not confirmed.

other_fees.label: Deposits
other_fees.note: Bank transfer, Visa, Mastercard, Klarna, Skrill and Brite. The client's bank may still charge.

other_fees.label: Inactivity fee
other_fees.note: Charged if no transactions in the previous 24 months, no open positions, and balance above zero. Valid as of 01.09.2017.

other_fees.label: Currency conversion on stocks and ETFs
other_fees.note: Minimum 0.01 units of account currency, when the instrument currency differs from the account currency.

other_fees.label: Withdrawal after the free monthly request
other_fees.value: Bank transfer 1 EUR, or 1 USD, and other currency amounts listed on the page. Card and Skrill 1% with a minimum of 1 in
other_fees.note: One free withdrawal request every month.

_notes.fetch_notes: Fetched on 2026-10-11. Homepage says 25+ years and over 25 years as a regulated broker, but no founding year and no street address. The account-types table did not render, so only the notes on that page were available. MT4 page also says investor compensation up to 20,000 EUR via the Investor Compensation Fund, plus up to 100,000 EUR supplementary insurance, terms apply. The leverage policy page still uses the former name Admiral Markets Cyprus Ltd.
